attributes.name: Crystalline Carnivore
attributes.powers:
Banish this card to add 1 die to a combat check by a character at your location, or to evade a bane you encounter, or to ignore a non-villain bane's powers that happen before or after you act.

Banish this card to explore your location. During this exploration, add 1 die to your combat checks.

After playing this card, you may succeed at a Craft 11 check; then discard a card that has the Alchemical trait to recharge this card instead of banishing it.
